Experience excellence with our home comfort services with our trusted team of experts. From installation to repair, we ensure top-notch solutions tailored to your needs.

Incomplete, incorrect, or late submissions will not be accepted. All rebate submissions are subject to verification. Approval is not guaranteed and is contingent on compliance with the rebate criteria. NearU and Happy Home are not responsible for lost, late, misdirected, or incomplete submissions. The company is not liable for any customer failure to follow the rebate process or for disqualifications resulting from non-compliance with these terms. All decisions regarding rebate eligibility and disbursement are determined by the rebate provider.
